## BUSSENSE Pull Request

### Task
- What task/roadmap item does this PR complete?

### Scope
- [ ] Changes stay inside the assigned ownership boundary.
- [ ] No unrelated refactoring or feature creep.

### Contracts
- [ ] `API_CONTRACT.md` unchanged.
- [ ] `EVENT_CONTRACT.md` unchanged.
- [ ] Other frozen contracts unchanged.
- [ ] If a shared-contract change is genuinely required, Integration Lead approval is documented.

### Testing
- [ ] Relevant unit tests run.
- [ ] Relevant integration tests run.
- [ ] Frontend build/lint run if frontend changed.
- [ ] No known failing checks are hidden.

### Dependencies
- [ ] No dependency change.
- [ ] Dependency change is documented and justified.

### Safety
- [ ] No secrets committed.
- [ ] No runtime database, queue, model binary, or generated evidence committed.
- [ ] Simulated/demo behavior is clearly identified.

### Integration
- [ ] Cross-module impact reviewed.
- [ ] Known limitations documented.
- [ ] Ready for Integration Lead review.
